body.p:
Tawkxwax met a stork (tsiyá, probably Ardea galatea). He was standing on one leg as is his custom. The other leg was tucked under his feathers. Tawkxwax became very interested and asked the stork how it was possible to do this;
he added that he would like to do the same. The stork said the only thing to do was to cut off one leg. Tawkxwax asked how the leg could be put back again and the stork replied that there was nothing more simple, he said, "You have only to jump on a certain kind of wood and you will recover your leg." Tawkxwax asked the stork for a demonstration so the stork hopped to a certain branch and lowered his leg. Tawkxwax asked the stork to cut his leg off. After his leg had been removed Tawkxwax jumped on a branch as the stork had done but his leg did not grow back. Tawkxwax called the tarantula siwanoʟokwetax and told him that he would give his daughter in marriage to have his leg replaced. Tawkxwax s daughter was a beauty and as the spider desired her he put Tawkxwax's leg back on, but Tawkxwax refused to keep his promise. Tawkxwax then climbed a tree, he fell and broke his leg. He asked the tarantula again to mend his leg but the spider refused. Tawkxwax would have remained with one leg had it not been for a smaller spider who put his leg back on for him.
